newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Student kills self, four others with poisoned wine.
newsitem.headline: Student kills self, four others with poisoned wine.

text.p: A crazed nursing student killed himself and four classmates with poisoned sherry during a day trip to a town just north of Bogota on Saturday, police said.

Four men and a woman were dead. At least six other people, all nursing students, were in critical condition at the hospital in the town of Cajica, a short drive outside the capital, regional police chief Col. Alonso Arango said.
Police said one of the victims told them before dying that a male student on the bus was passing out the wine and he was the apparent killer.
Toxicology checks showed the sherry had been laced with a lethal insecticide commonly used to combat potato bugs, Arango said. He said no motive for the murders had yet been estalished.

Police found a card in the clothes of one of the dead indicating he was a member of a shadowy sect called the Order of Aquarius. Arango said it was too early to say whether the bizarre killings were linked to the suspected religious group, adding that he knew very little about them.

"We found a membership card of a sect called the Order of Aquarius on one of the bodies. We know very little about the group. It is too early to tell if these deaths are related to a religious cult," Arango told Reuters.

The dead and injured were all part of a 200-strong group that set out from Bogota in several buses to celebrate the graduation of 46 of the nursing students. They had been going for a meal at the Indiana Jones restaurant between Cajica and the neighbouring town of Chia.
